A '''contact team''' was a unit of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] members [[First mission to Hargeeva|tasked]] with contacting potential allies and defectors. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], a contact team led by the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Merak (Human)|Merak]] attempted to recruit [[Ketrian Altronel]] on [[Hargeeva]].
